[RDSC.6.8.4] The compiler generates `name_template` from the
rule's LHS patterns. The template is the rule name, `(`, one entry
per contributing pattern in source order separated by `, `, and `)`.
Each entry is `<binding>={<binding>.<slot>}`: `<binding>` is the
pattern's binding ([RDSC.6.8.9]), and `<slot>` is the first `key`
slot the schema declares ([LFAC.1.7]), or the first slot it declares
when it declares no `key` slot. A rule `alert_high` binding `s` to a
schema keyed on `entity_id` therefore carries the template
`alert_high(s={s.entity_id})`. The placeholder form is [RDSC.6.8.3];
which patterns contribute is [RDSC.6.8.5] and [RDSC.6.8.6].
